statusDetail: Coverage complete: all 58 catalog checks received conclusive outcomes.

page.notes: Public Apple App Store catalog. Entry redirects to /us/iphone/today. Representative coverage includes landing, listing, detail, editorial story and invalid-route recovery. Excluded: native App Store purchase/install handoff, authenticated account flows, every locale/device variant, and exhaustive app/story instances because they share templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The light screenshot uses light system surfaces while the default dark capture uses dark surfaces; rendered CSS declares color-scheme: light dark and system color tokens.
The emulated preference matched, no active animations remained, and five reduced-motion media rules were present.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse contrast audit and prefers-contrast screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse color-contrast passed and the prefers-contrast: more screenshot retained legible text, icons and controls.
Representative route loads changed immediately and authored CSS exposed only short opacity transitions; no View Transition API or ::view-transition integration was found for route continuity.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inspection and trace long-task review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Long content shelves use native overflow/scroll presentation; inspection found no continuous script-driven scroll animation and the trace showed only three bounded long tasks.
Horizontal shelves and mobile navigation use native scrolling/touch surfaces with no evidence of pointermove-based gesture reimplementation.
Desktop keeps a stable side rail while mobile collapses it to a compact header, preserving content space and orientation without intrusive floating chrome.
No tooltip, context-menu, or edge-sensitive anchored overlay was required in the exercised catalog, detail, editorial, or discovery flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, context-menu, or edge-sensitive anchored overlay was required in the exercised catalog, detail, editorial, or discovery flow.

checkOutcomes.method: visual review of first viewport and detail/listing templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Each template uses a single H1, prominent hero or app identity, selected navigation state, and clear View links to direct attention.

checkOutcomes.method: load screenshots on four representative templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: No consent wall, modal, newsletter prompt, or full-viewport interruption obscured content on load.
The rendered DOM exposed dialog/role-dialog surfaces rather than an unlabelled full-screen interruption; no forced overlay appeared during the exercised flow.
The compact side rail becomes a 44px mobile header; the rest of the viewport is devoted to catalog content and primary details.
Home and story reported zero overflow; listing and detail reported only a 2px viewport-rounding delta, with no visible clipped content in mobile captures.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS rule probe plus mobile/desktop comparisons
checkOutcomes.evidence: The live stylesheet contained 30 @container rules and cards/navigation visibly reflowed between 780px and 360px.
The first 20 focusable controls reported outline-style none, including search and primary navigation links, so keyboard focus lacks a dependable visible indicator.
Today, Apps, story and app-detail templates state their purpose immediately and expose direct View/detail links with clear hierarchy.

checkOutcomes.method: navigation walkthrough from Today to listing, editorial story and app detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Prominent href-backed cards and navigation reached rendered listing, story and Roblox detail templates without authentication or dead ends.
The 404 state says only “The page you’re looking for can’t be found” and offers no contextual recovery action in the content pane.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse mobile audit corroborated by trace/layout
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 12.5s, FCP 5.8s and TBT 262ms (performance 0.52); the trace still measured LCP 2.71s and 137ms TBT under a lighter run, so load performance is condition-sensitive and fails the lab mobile bar.

checkOutcomes.method: layout shift observers on four templates and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: All representative layout captures and Lighthouse reported CLS 0 with dimensions reserved.
Lighthouse measured 4.4s main-thread work, 2.1s JavaScript execution and 262ms TBT; the trace recorded three long tasks and 137ms TBT.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, Lighthouse and DOM head inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: HAR recorded a redirect, parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets and 1.66MB initial transfer; Lighthouse found 30,047KiB total payload, 750ms render-blocking savings and 480ms document-latency savings. The parser script is type=module and was not treated as blocking.
Lighthouse estimated 642KiB unused JavaScript (including 75.8% of the 622KiB main bundle) and 37KiB unused CSS (78.1% of the stylesheet).

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit and rendered DOM
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found focusable descendants inside aria-hidden navigation and multiple cards whose visible label text did not match the accessible name.
Lighthouse reported no color-contrast failures on the audited mobile surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse heading audit plus computed focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found H1-to-H3 heading skips, and the focus probe found outline-style none on search and navigation controls.
Body, heading, rating and metadata text remained readable with clear hierarchy and sensible line lengths across representative templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse target-size audit and mobile layouts
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile layouts reflowed without meaningful overflow, but Lighthouse found footer language links only 10px high with insufficient spacing.
Lighthouse reported no browser console errors during page load.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, images primitive and Lighthouse best-practices
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document has an HTML doctype, UTF-8 charset and viewport; Lighthouse passed responsive image sizing/aspect ratio and the layout observer reported CLS 0.
The best-practices category scored 1.0, but Lighthouse separately reported missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript, limiting production diagnostics.

checkOutcomes.method: head metadata probe and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage has a descriptive title but no meta description; Lighthouse failed the meta-description audit.
Raw HTML retained 98% of rendered content, anchors have real hrefs, the viewport meta is present, and robots.txt permits public catalog paths.

checkOutcomes.method: head metadata plus robots/sitemap HTTP inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage returned 200 and robots.txt points to six sitemap indexes, but the page has no canonical link or hreflang signals despite locale/storefront variants.
The homepage exposed no JSON-LD and no Open Graph metadata, leaving catalog/editorial content without machine-readable or social-preview context.
HTTPS, HSTS, CSP, nosniff and frame denial are present; the secrets scan found no exposed sensitive credentials.
No known tracker domains were detected; cross-origin requests were confined to Apple/mzstatic delivery, media and telemetry origins, with no third-party cookies.
No permission request, sign-in, registration, or authentication surface appeared in the public browse/detail journeys tested.
checkOutcomes.reason: No permission request, sign-in, registration, or authentication surface appeared in the public browse/detail journeys tested.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers were absent, CSP permits unsafe-inline styles, and the geo cookie was set without Secure and with SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: discoverability primitive with JavaScript-disabled crawler view
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw server HTML returned 200 and retained 98% of rendered content, including title and H1; the crawler screenshot remained useful.
Listing, detail, editorial and invalid routes all rendered stable states without uncaught console errors or broken navigation chrome.

checkOutcomes.method: manifest fetch and service-worker registration probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: A standalone manifest exists, but it has no start_url and the live page had zero service-worker registrations, so offline/installable behavior is incomplete.
The not-found route presents a clear message but no retry, home link, search prompt, or other recovery control in the main state.
The document declares lang=en-US and dir=ltr; CSS uses start-aligned declarations and the footer exposes multiple locale links.

checkOutcomes.method: global storefront and rendered locale affordance review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The storefront identifies en-US and provides explicit localized page links including Arabic, Korean, French, Portuguese and Chinese variants.
The representative catalog, app-detail and editorial surfaces contained no user-entered or scheduled date/time workflow requiring time-zone conversion.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative catalog, app-detail and editorial surfaces contained no user-entered or scheduled date/time workflow requiring time-zone conversion.

checkOutcomes.method: visual review of browse and app-detail journeys
checkOutcomes.evidence: No consent manipulation, forced signup, disguised advertisement, confirmshaming, or obstructed cancellation appeared in the public flows.
The only form is catalog search; there is no required multi-field data-entry submission for which validation timing or aria-invalid behavior applies.
checkOutcomes.reason: The only form is catalog search; there is no required multi-field data-entry submission for which validation timing or aria-invalid behavior applies.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No sign-in, address, payment, or account fields appeared; search intentionally uses autocomplete=off and does not collect identity data.
checkOutcomes.reason: No sign-in, address, payment, or account fields appeared; search intentionally uses autocomplete=off and does not collect identity data.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Web browsing exposes product information and external View actions, but no checkout, subscription, account, or reauthentication flow was available on the audited site.
checkOutcomes.reason: Web browsing exposes product information and external View actions, but no checkout, subscription, account, or reauthentication flow was available on the audited site.

checkOutcomes.method: images primitive, HAR and Lighthouse image audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Rendered delivery used appropriately sized WebP artwork in the HAR; Lighthouse passed image sizing/aspect ratio and estimated a comparatively small 157KiB image opportunity.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse payload and HAR media review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The mobile load fetched or discovered many high-resolution trailer variants; Lighthouse attributed roughly 30MB largely to 1.3–4.8MB video files despite a browse-first task.
HAR recorded 47 cross-origin requests and 723KB initial cross-origin transfer; Lighthouse’s fuller run reached 30,047KiB, dominated by Apple trailer media variants.
This is a public browse/catalog surface with no declared agent action workflow; lack of WebMCP tools is not treated as a defect for the audited intent.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a public browse/catalog surface with no declared agent action workflow; lack of WebMCP tools is not treated as a defect for the audited intent.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation, or other inference feature is part of the public App Store web journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation, generation, or other inference feature is part of the public App Store web journey.

checkOutcomes.method: heap baseline followed by ten open/dismiss attempts and post snapshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten repeated country-control open/dismiss attempts, heap self size decreased from 36,274,590 to 36,266,169 bytes; node count rose only 1,023 (0.17%), with no retained-size growth signal.
The loaded content-rich catalog retained a 36.3MB self-size heap; this is bounded and proportionate to the large rendered catalog, though network/code costs remain separate findings.
The repeated interaction produced no material total retained-size growth; constructor summaries showed no growing Detached* population among dominant constructors.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this public browse/catalog journey.

paths.description: Redirected Today landing page, representing editorial discovery and global navigation.
Roblox product detail, representing app identity, ratings and media.
Essential iPhone Games, representing editorial story content.
Invalid public route, representing HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

findings.summary: Slow mobile rendering delays the catalog
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 12.5s, FCP 5.8s and performance 0.52; trace LCP was 2.71s under a lighter run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the hero/LCP resource, remove the initial redirect for canonical entry links, and shorten critical request chains.

findings.summary: Main-thread and unused-code costs are substantial
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 4.4s main-thread work, 2.1s JS execution, 262ms TBT, 642KiB unused JS and 37KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split route/media features, defer HLS and noncritical modules, and break long startup tasks into scheduled chunks.

findings.summary: Trailer delivery creates an excessive mobile payload
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 30,047KiB total payload dominated by multiple 1.3–4.8MB trailer variants; HAR recorded 47 cross-origin requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Load poster images first, defer trailer manifests/code until explicit intent or proximity, and request only the selected rendition.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse found focusable navigation links inside an aria-hidden=true container.
findings.suggestedFix: When collapsed, use inert/hidden or remove descendants from tab order; synchronize aria-hidden with the actual expanded state.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated
findings.evidence: Computed styles for search and primary navigation reported outline-style none; Lighthouse also found skipped heading levels.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and make heading levels reflect document hierarchy.

findings.summary: Footer locale links have undersized touch targets
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured locale links at only 10px high with insufficient safe spacing.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each locale link at least a 24x24 CSS-pixel target and adequate separation, preferably 44px for comfortable touch use.

findings.summary: Homepage search and share metadata is incomplete
findings.evidence: The head probe and Lighthouse found no meta description; the page also had no JSON-LD or Open Graph tags.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise unique description plus accurate Open Graph and schema.org metadata for each catalog archetype.

findings.summary: Canonical and locale indexing signals are absent
findings.evidence: The public homepage has no canonical or hreflang links, despite locale/storefront variants; robots.txt does advertise sitemap indexes.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonical and reciprocal hreflang links for storefront variants, preserving valid sitemap indexes.

findings.summary: Defensive policies and the geo cookie need tightening
findings.evidence: Headers lacked Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; CSP allows unsafe-inline styles; geo was SameSite=None without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Set explicit restrictive policies, mark cross-site cookies Secure, and reduce unsafe-inline using nonces/hashes or extracted styles.

findings.summary: The PWA manifest does not provide offline behavior
findings.evidence: The standalone manifest has no start_url and the service-worker probe found zero registrations.
findings.suggestedFix: Either complete the installable experience with start_url, service worker and tested offline fallback, or remove standalone installability signaling.

findings.summary: The not-found state has no recovery action
findings.evidence: The invalid-route screenshot shows only a not-found sentence with no home, search, back, or retry control.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prominent return-to-Today link and search affordance while preserving the clear error message.

findings.evidence: Representative route loads expose no View Transition integration, so context changes abruptly between dense templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for the content pane, with a reduced-motion fallback and stable navigation chrome.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish protected production source maps to the error-monitoring/debug pipeline or expose suitable maps where policy permits.

findings.summary: Card accessible names do not include visible labels
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple story cards whose aria-label omitted visible category or descriptive text.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure each card’s accessible name contains its visible label text, or remove redundant aria-label values and rely on semantic text.

taskList.title: Defer and right-size trailer delivery; split startup code
Repair hidden-navigation semantics and visible keyboard focus
Add complete description, canonical, hreflang and share metadata
Complete or remove partial installability signaling
